newsitem.title: USA: Pease Oil takes on Gulf Coast consultant.
newsitem.headline: Pease Oil takes on Gulf Coast consultant.

text.p: Pease Oil and Gas Co said R. T. "Tom" Fetters Jr had joined the company as its consulting manager of Gulf Coast acquisition and exploration.
As part of a one-year consulting agreement, Fetters will also assume a seat on the company's board, it said.
Pease said Fetters will focus his efforts on exploration, exploitation and acquisitions.
A petroleum geologist, Fetters is chairman of Global Group, a closely-held international oil, gas and mining company that he founded in 1995.
